newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK can be Asia Pacific's debt market centre - BoC.
newsitem.headline: HK can be Asia Pacific's debt market centre - BoC.

text.p: Hong Kong can become the Asia Pacific's debt market centre if its development speeds up, the Bank of China said on Monday.
Hong Kong's financial markets, the most open in the region, could attract foreign issuers, the bank said in a research report.

The territory could also benefit from the growing amount of Chinese debt instruments, which were often issued through Hong Kong where players understood China's economic and political situation far better than any other part of the world did.
Hong Kong's measures to speed up development of its debt market, such as tax concessions for issuers of debt in Hong Kong, also helped the development of its debt market, the report said.
It noted the territory needed to speed up the development its debt market, partly because it was a relatively weak sector in Hong Kong's financial market at present.
Accelerating its development would also help satisfy the region's fast-growing need for debt issuance, and raise the territory's status as an international financial centre, the report said.
